guide.title: Quick guide
guide.welcome_body: Everything runs on your device — files never leave your machine.
guide.start_body: Drag a PDF or images anywhere on the page — the app suggests the right tool. Or open a tool directly and pick a file there.
guide.tools_body: Merge, split, reorder, rotate, extract pages, remove pages, compress, PDF→images, images→PDF, encrypt, metadata, sign, fill forms, OCR.
guide.ai_body: Extract text from scans with an AI model running on your GPU. The model (~650 MB) downloads once, stays on your device, and can be deleted anytime in Settings → Storage. Prefer not to? Tesseract works instantly with no download.
guide.privacy_body: 100% on-device processing — nothing is uploaded, no account needed, and every tool works offline.
guide.settings_body: Manage storage (AI model, OCR data), benchmark your GPU/CPU, switch light/dark theme and language.
guide.desktop_body: The Windows/macOS/Linux app checks for updates on its own; every save opens the native Save-As dialog so you pick where files land.

ocr.drop_hint: One PDF (scan/image). Text is recognized entirely on your device.

ocr.cancelled_partial: Stopped — keeping results for {{count}} recognized pages.
ocr.engine_tesseract_hint: Clean printed text, light (~3MB language data), outputs searchable PDF.
ocr.engine_ai_hint: Tables, multi-column, poor scans; outputs structured text/markdown. ~652MB model, one-time download.
ocr.engine_native_hint: Same GLM-OCR model on a native engine — several times faster. Desktop-only; ~1.4GB one-time download.
ocr.native_notice: Runs entirely on this machine via a bundled llama.cpp engine. The first run downloads the engine and model once.
ocr.native_backend_cpu_fallback: No GPU backend found — running on CPU (slower).
ocr.native_suggest_title: Try the native engine — significantly faster
ocr.native_suggest_body: The in-app AI engine is running slowly on this machine. The native engine (llama.cpp + GPU) can be several times faster: one-time ~32MB engine + ~1.4GB model download. The in-app engine stays the default.
ocr.native_cpu_gate_title: No GPU device found for the native engine
ocr.native_cpu_gate_body: The native engine will run on CPU — possibly SLOWER than the in-app engine. Continue anyway?
ocr.native_err_oom: The native engine ran out of memory loading the model. {{detail}} Try closing other apps, or use CUDA if you have an NVIDIA card.
ocr.native_err_quarantined: The engine binary is missing or blocked (often by antivirus). {{detail}} Check Windows Defender's protection history to restore it, or re-download the engine.
ocr.native_err_os_blocked: The engine launch was blocked by the OS (unverified origin). {{detail}} macOS: remove the quarantine attribute (xattr) or approve in System Settings.
ocr.native_err_os_too_old: The operating system is too old for this engine. {{detail}}
ocr.native_err_load_failed: The engine failed to load the model. {{detail}}
ocr.native_err_spawn: The engine could not be launched. {{detail}}
ocr.ai_tier_weak: Runs, but slowly on this GPU — estimate ~1 minute per page.
ocr.ai_tier_cpu: Not recommended: this machine falls back to software rendering, very slow. Use Tesseract.
ocr.ai_tier_none: This browser has no WebGPU — only Tesseract is available.
ocr.ai_notice: The AI model (~652MB) downloads once from HuggingFace and stays on your device; later runs are offline. Your files never leave the machine. AI mode outputs text/markdown/html — searchable PDF is a Tesseract-mode feature.
ocr.preflight_tight_title: This machine may be short on memory for full mode

ocr.preflight_full_hint: 1024px images, up to 4096 tokens — slower/oom risk on tight memory.
ocr.preflight_reduced_hint: 768px images, capped at 2048 tokens — long pages may be cut short.
ocr.preflight_tesseract_hint: Prefer the classic route? Switch the engine to Tesseract above.
ocr.ai_download_hint: A half-downloaded file cannot be paused — “Cancel” stops at the nearest file boundary; completed files are kept.
ocr.ai_cancel_hint: “Cancel” stops after the current page and keeps the results so far.
ocr.ai_loading: Loading the model onto the GPU…
ocr.ai_pdf_note: AI results export as a searchable PDF (page image + invisible text layer), plus markdown/text/html.
ocr.pdf_quality_hint: Changes the saved PDF’s image resolution only — recognition quality is unaffected. Compact ≈ 150 KB/page; Archive is about 4× larger.

settings.row_ocr_idb_hint: Tesseract's gunzipped traineddata copies. Deleting only this: the next run re-extracts from the cache, no download.
settings.row_precache_hint: The web app copy used offline. Deleting unregisters, clears and reloads the page.
settings.row_native_engine_hint: The AI Native (beta) desktop engine: llama-server + GLM-OCR model + CUDA add-on. Desktop builds only.
settings.precache_offline: Offline — cannot clean now (the app could not open until you're back online)
settings.in_memory_note: Zip/thumbnail data lives in browser memory and frees when the tab closes — no other background cache exists.
settings.unknown_title: Data not owned by this app
settings.unknown_hint: These stores share the origin but are not managed by PDF Toolkit (shared github.io origin). Display only — no delete.
settings.tier_gpu-strong: Strong GPU — AI OCR runs fast
settings.hw_no_bench: Never measured — run a 2-page AI OCR to get a real number.
settings.hw_stale: GPU configuration changed since the last measurement — re-measure recommended.
settings.hw_remeasure_needs_model: Download the AI model first (OCR tool page).
settings.gpu_missing: Selected GPU no longer available — using automatic ({{label}})
settings.gpu_apply_hint: Applies without an app restart — the model reloads onto the chosen card.
settings.gpu_busy_error: The AI engine is running — apply is disabled until the job finishes.
settings.gpu_measure_mismatch: Note: the engine ran on {{actual}} instead of {{expected}} — the record was keyed to what actually ran.
settings.gpu_force_hint: Windows may hand the app the integrated card regardless of this choice. This toggle launches the app with a flag requesting the discrete card — it may have no effect on older runtimes, and if no discrete card is found the AI engine is disabled (a revert button appears below).
settings.gpu_force_suggestion: Windows may be limiting the app to 1 card — try forcing the discrete card.
settings.gpu_force_recovery: The force-dGPU toggle is ON but no discrete card was found — the AI engine is disabled. Turn the flag off to restore WebGPU.
settings.gpu_windows_note: Windows can still route the app to a different card (Settings → System → Display → Graphics → add PDF Toolkit / the WebView2 runtime → High performance). The app can only REQUEST an adapter — the honest status line says what was requested, never what the OS delivered.
settings.native_intro: A llama.cpp sidecar engine running on this machine — same GLM-OCR model, several times faster. All data stays local.
settings.native_resume_note: A partial download resumes where it stopped on the next launch — never from scratch.
settings.native_cuda_hint: The CUDA backend for NVIDIA GPUs — instead of Vulkan. Requires an NVIDIA card; ~600 MB extra download.

editor.edit_whiteout_placeholder: Leave empty for a pure white-out
editor.crop_hint: Drag a box on the page, then apply. Current page only, or all pages.

redact.mode_surgical_note: Removes only text fully inside the marked regions; pages keep vectors and stay searchable. Everything is re-verified afterwards.
redact.mode_raster_note: Every marked page is replaced by an image (marked regions painted black first) — the guaranteed mode, but those pages stop being searchable.
redact.secrets_hint: One keyword per line (or comma-separated). Keywords are scrubbed from document channels (title, metadata, form values…) and drive the final residue scan of the output file.
redact.census_note: These pages carry hidden text layers or special constructs (pattern glyphs, OCR layers, hidden annotations…). By default they are burned to images to strip the hidden layers; mark directly over content you want covered.
redact.scrub_note: These channels match your keywords and will be cleaned on run. Uncheck to keep a channel.
redact.confirm_budget: Continue anyway — more than {{count}} pages become images
redact.budget_note: More pages than recommended would be burned — the file gets heavy and those pages stop being searchable. Click the button once more to continue.
redact.marks_hint: Drag to mark regions to redact. Click a mark to remove it.
redact.report_escalated: Pages {{pages}} could not be cleaned surgically and were burned safely.
redact.err_no_marks: Mark at least one region (or choose page burn) first.
redact.err_no_secrets: Enter at least one sensitive keyword — required for the final residue scan.
redact.err_signed: The file carries a digital signature — redaction would invalidate it, so it is refused. Export an unsigned copy first.
redact.err_partial: Some pages are only partially covered — refusing to shred the text. Expand the marks or use "Safe page burn". ({{pages}})
redact.err_flagged: A page carries constructs that force rasterization. ({{pages}})
redact.err_refused: This file cannot be redacted safely (common causes: digital signatures, vertical text, unusual structures). Try "Safe page burn" for the affected pages.
redact.err_verify: The final scan found leftover sensitive data — the output was discarded, nothing was downloaded. Expand your marks or burn the page.
redact.err_parse: The file has an unusual structure — nothing was changed. Try "Safe page burn".
redact.err_crashed_detail: The worker stopped mid-run. Press Retry to start over.
